description: UAE -> Germany. SLOT-CHECK ONLY: reach Step 1 (Appointment Details), then for each centre/category/sub-category combination read the 'Earliest available slot' banner and report all results via Telegram. No booking is made. NOTE: the combinations below are PLACEHOLDERS mirroring the Hungary layout — verify the real centre/category/sub-category dropdown values on the German portal (and set "otp": true if it requires an emailed code) before uncommenting AE-DEU in config/vfs_urls.ini.

slot_check._comment_labels: Labels must be UNIQUE within a route — a waitlist client file names the combination it wants by label, and duplicates would silently resolve to whichever came first. These four previously used just two labels between them; each now carries its category.
slot_check._comment_centre_bug: UNVERIFIED: the two 'Dubai' rows still have centre = 'Germany Visa Application Centre- Abu Dhabi', which looks like a copy-paste error carried over from the Abu Dhabi rows. It has never surfaced because AE-DEU is commented out in config/vfs_urls.ini. Confirm the real Dubai centre string on the portal before enabling this route.
